DO & CO is one of the world's leading premium hospitality and catering companies, employing more than 17,000 people across over 20 countries. Our group includes the renowned brands k. & k. Hofzuckerbäckerei Demel, HENRY and HEDIARD. 

DO & CO operates in Austria, Türkiye, Germany, England, Spain, Italy, Poland, South Korea and the United States. 

DO & CO delivers exceptional culinary experiences, from fine-dining to international events such as UEFA Champions League Finals, FIFA World Cups and Formula 1. We combine culinary excellence and outstanding service to create unforgettable experiences worldwide.

 * Development of menus and food concepts

Qualifications

 * 6+ years of professional experience in luxury gastronomy with a focus on Italian cuisine

 * Completed culinary training

 * Flexibility and willingness to travel to F1 races internationally

 * Efficient and flexible working style

 * Performance-driven mindset and strong team spirit

 * Valid work permit for Austria

 * Excellent English skills (written and spoken); other languages are an advantage

Additional Information

YOUR WORKING ENVIRONMENT

 * An exciting mix of international events and traditional restaurant operations

 * The opportunity to be part of the exclusive world of Formula 1

 * Close collaboration with Executive Chefs around the world

 * Individual long-term career opportunities within the DO & CO Group

 * Attractive above-market compensation, including travel expenses and allowances

 * Daily complimentary freshly prepared lunch and fruit

OUR ATTRACTIVE OFFER

A gross monthly salary of €5,500 per month on a full-time basis (All-In contract). Willingness to overpay depends on qualifications and individual agreement. Additional compensation for F1 event assignments.

Must be willing to relocate to Vienna. A valid work permit for Austria is required.
